pr.body:
Implements an opt-in native accepted-segment certificate for the conditional scalar-affine IVP y'=-lambda*y+b. Exact stored RODAS H/stages/endpoints form a quartic; outward Bernstein/Dini bounds certify whole-slab defect/state error and strict event predicates. Actual dense-query output receives a separate pointwise rounding enclosure. Source/clock/unit/event/epoch changes and invalid adjacent error carry refuse reuse.

Validation: 13 new contract tests + 8 existing fast-dense regressions passed; strict Clippy/rustfmt passed. Independent Fraction-from-bits audit passed 381 checks (367 exact comparisons + 14 Decimal90 diagnostics) across 6 records/42 queries, including 2 actual native accepted segments. Separate theory diagnostics: 324 rational cases, 16,524 exact algebra assertions and 11,016 high-precision samples. Independent scientific/code and result/PNG reviews report zero blockers.

R1-R10 and C1-C10:20/20; auxiliary SYM02:1/1 PASS_SCOPED_NATIVE_AFFINE. Original core7/23 is inherited scoped status, delta0; central REI28/88 remains separate. The broad production/authority/GMRES/physical-client gates remain HOLD; remote failing workflows are retained in REMOTE_CI_STATUS.json.

Verified code commit:0d722b4ed71413926c76bc0037f02f3a6bbdd362. Read research/sym02_native_affine_20261029/REPORT_KO.md, ADMISSION.json, FINAL_SOURCE_IDENTITY.json, DAG_BASIS.json and NEXT_THREAD_HANDOFF_KO.md. Each stage has a committed checkpoint and actual Drive/Dropbox source-ZIP acknowledgement, with SHA256 receipts. Caller-supplied affine source/parameter/initial-error premises remain explicit; this does not supply an actual BASS30 nonlinear provider.
